'''Matthew Schultheis''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Clarks Summit tournament]] on 2001 with Senate deck, according to Jake Rich's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2941">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-06-2-or-bust-clarks-summitd2941/ 2-or-bust-clarks-summit], DeckTech (Jake "NeDraco" Rich, 6 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-06-2-or-bust-clarks-summitd2941/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
